gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-huninn: Huninn keeps its s terminals away from the body and makes crossbars as fat as their stems. Huninn then sits under Conthrax, whose lowercase is so tall the capitals barely rise above it.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-inter-tight: Inter Tight has short ascenders and tails held well back from its curves. Beneath Conthrax, with its tall-bodied lowercase, it feels compact and quick, so the heading stretches out while the text stays tucked in.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-lexend-deca: Conthrax is all geometric display swagger, its tall lowercase nearly matching its capitals. Lexend Deca does the humbler job, an unshaded line with terminals that stop short of curling back.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-martel-sans: Martel Sans reads with generous openings in every curve. Under Conthrax, whose strokes run like solder through a nozzle, the text would settle into a high, steady line across every word.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-montserrat-underl: Round and breathing, Montserrat Underline has hollow-reed counters and lowercase that looks oversized beside its capitals. And Conthrax, with its tall bodies, makes a crisp geometric counterweight to that plain sans.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-mozilla-text: Neutral in mood, Mozilla Text still looks bold, since its lowercase bodies are so tall. Conthrax is the better showpiece for geometric lines, while the text face flares its terminals outward.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans: Contemporary in feel, Noto Sans fills most of its letter height with lowercase bodies and shows a generous, open c. Conthrax adds the counterpoint, every stroke kept uniform and geometric.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-adlam-u: Spacious and modern: Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined barely differs between its cases. Conthrax does the loud work with horizontals matching its verticals, while the sans leaves generous room between curve ends and stems.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-avestan: Conthrax pulls one plain stripe of constant ink through every letter. Noto Sans Avestan feels lighter beside it, its curve tips never touching and its x-height pronounced, a modern sans.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-noto-sans-deseret: Quiet, level and unhurried, Conthrax moves along with no accents of weight. Noto Sans Deseret then lifts the text with open apertures and a high, wide-looking lowercase, so the two feel friendly together.
